title: audiofreeze
description: `audiofreeze` takes an audio signal and, when triggered by its FREEZE control or trigger input, captures a snapshot of the spectral field and recreates it through resynthesis. It provides attack, decay, modulation rate and index, and dry/wet controls; its MODE selects either 8-partial resynthesis or FFT resynthesis at 512, 1024, or 2048 resolution.
